description: K₂NaNb₃O₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are four inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with eight KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.12 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with three KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.05 Å. In the third K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with eight KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.74-3.04 Å. In the fourth K site, K is bonded to twelve O atoms to form KO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with three KO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.06 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.99 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.83 Å. There are six inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.32 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with four KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-18°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.27 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-15°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.27 Å. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-18°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.29 Å. In the fifth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with four KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-18°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.26 Å. In the sixth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with six KO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.26 Å. There are eighteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K and two Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K and two Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two K, one Na, and two equivalent Nb atoms to form distorted OK₂NaNb₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent OK₄Nb₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OK₂NaNb₂ square pyramids, and faces with two equivalent OK₂Na₂Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 64°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two Nb atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two Nb atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to four K and two Nb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing OK₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-61°. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to four K and two Nb atoms to form distorted OK₄Nb₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent OK₄Nb₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OK₂NaNb₂ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent OK₄Nb₂ octahedra, and  a faceface with one OK₄Nb₂ octahedra. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two Nb atoms to form distorted OK₂Na₂Nb₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent OK₄Nb₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent OK₂Na₂Nb₂ octahedra, and  a faceface with one OK₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 61°. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two K, one Na, and two equivalent Nb atoms.
